paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama4 Scout (top) and Llama4 Maverick (bottom) on 5-digit multiplication.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Accuracy and Initial Confidence. The x-axis displays "Initial Confidence" on a linear scale, ranging from 0.91 to 0.98 with regularly spaced tick intervals of 0.01. The y-axis represents "Accuracy" on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with a tick interval of 0.2. Three distinct lines, each featuring error bars at the data points, are plotted on the graph. A solid blue line with circular markers begins at an accuracy of approximately 0.86 at an initial confidence of 0.91, rises to a peak of 1.0 at 0.92, remains relatively steady with a slight dip to roughly 0.97 at 0.94, and ends at 1.0 at 0.98. A dashed orange line with diamond markers starts at 0.64 at 0.91, reaches a peak of approximately 0.93 at 0.92, and then demonstrates a steady decline, finishing at 0.09 at 0.98. Finally, a dash-dot green line with square markers begins at 0.21 at 0.91, drops to a low of 0.08 at 0.92, and subsequently follows a consistent upward trend to conclude at approximately 0.91 at 0.98.
